title: PriCoRec: A Privacy-Aware Cloud-Device Collaborative Framework for Ad Recommendation under Feature Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.14429v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Privacy regulations increasingly restrict cloud processing of sensitive user data (e.g., age, gender), hindering traditional cloud-only recommendation models. To mitigate this challenge, we propose a Privacy-aware Collaborative cloud-device ads Recommendation framework (PriCoRec) which personalizes recommendations while keeping sensitive features on-device. While separating recommendation into cloud-based and on-device stages enables privacy-aware deployment, naive splitting suffers from degraded shortlist quality and inefficient on-device inference due to limited private features. We therefore design a collaborative framework that comprises a cloud-based pre-ranking stage using cloud-accessible features, and an on-device ranking stage that locally incorporates highly personalized features. translated_title: PriCoRec：一种在特征约束下用于广告推荐的可感知隐私的云设备协同框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14429v1 公告类型：新 摘要：隐私法规日益限制云对敏感用户数据（如年龄、性别）的处理，阻碍了传统仅基于云的推荐模型。为缓解这一挑战，我们提出了一种可感知隐私的协同云设备广告推荐框架（PriCoRec），该框架在保持敏感特征于设备端的同时实现个性化推荐。将推荐分离为云端和设备端阶段可实现隐私感知部署，但简单的拆分因有限的私有特征而遭受候选列表质量下降和设备端推理效率低下的问题。因此，我们设计了一个协同框架，包括使用云可访问特征的基于云的预排序阶段，以及本地整合高度个性化特征的设备端排序阶段。我们引入了一个多样性正则化器到预排序中以提高候选质量。此外，为控制设备功耗和计算成本...
tldr: 提出一种云设备协同的隐私感知广告推荐框架，通过多样性正则化器优化预排序候选质量，并在设备端本地处理敏感特征，以平衡隐私保护与推荐性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a privacy-aware cloud-device collaborative ads recommendation framework that improves candidate quality via a diversity regularizer in pre-ranking while keeping sensitive features on-device, balancing privacy and performance.
